Module advanceWars
Package co.edu.unbosque.controller

Class Controller

java.lang.Object
co.edu.unbosque.controller.Controller
All Implemented Interfaces:
ActionListener, KeyListener, EventListener
public class Controller extends Object implements KeyListener, ActionListener
The Controller class handles user interactions with the graphical interface and game logic. graphical interface and game logic. It implements keyboard events and actions on the user interface buttons. This class coordinates the interactions between the view ViewFacade and the model ModelFacade. model ModelFacade, allowing the manipulation of units and game features through various features of the game through various events such as the keyboard and actions on the buttons.
Author:
Bustamante Castellanos Caren Sofia, Hospital Herrera Dylan Mathyus, Ramirez Chacon Alejandra Valenttina, Ruiz Cruz Gabriel Alejandro, Triana Mejia Juan Diego, Vela Cardozo German Octavio

    • disparar

      public void disparar()
      Executes an attack between an attacking and defending unit, applying damage based on their types. If the units belong to the same team, the attack is canceled. The method calculates and applies attack and counterattack damage, removing units from the board if their health reaches zero. Includes debug messages with details about unit types, teams, and remaining health.

    • correrGUI

      public void correrGUI()
      Launches the graphical user interface (GUI) for the application and plays background audio. The GUI is made visible, and an audio file located in the resources directory is played. The method also pauses the current thread for the duration of the audio playback.
